The '''''Corpulentus''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] and the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pors Tonith/Legends|Pors Tonith]]. It was destroyed at the [[Battle of Praesitlyn]].
